Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 95: April 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #95 shipped to subscribers in March 2009 (bearing the cover date of April 2009 for Issue 95). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #95 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive media previews:

Red Faction: Guerrilla (open-world destruction action)
Sacred 2: Fallen Angel (action-RPG)
Bionic Commando (third-person grapple action)
Battlestations: Pacific (naval and air combat action-strategy)
Virtual On: Oratan Shooki (Xbox Live Arcade mecha 3D fighting)
Banjo-Tooie (Xbox Live Arcade classic 3D platformer port)
Space Invaders Extreme (Xbox Live Arcade arcade shooter remaster)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Halo 3: ODST, Mafia II, and Mass Effect 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
